items.title: Using Social Media for Business Promotion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Using Social Media for Business Promotion (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: Digital platforms entrepreneurs ko online karobar shuru karne, chalane aur barhane ke tools dete hain (yeh Figure 9.5 mein dikhaya gaya hai). In platforms mein social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing marketplaces shamil hain. Social media products ki promotion (tashheer) aur bohat se logon tak jaldi pohanchne mein madad deta hai. E-commerce platforms physical dukaan ke baghair cheezein khareedne bechne dete hain. Freelancing websites duniya bhar mein apni skills aur services pesh karne ke mauqe deti hain, jis se entrepreneurship aasan aur sab ki pohanch mein ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab digital platforms (social media, e-commerce, freelancing) ke paragraph mein "as shown in Figure 9.4" likhti hai. Lekin Figure 9.4 technology par mabni hal (taleem, sehat, zaraat, karobar) dikhati hai; platforms wali tasveer Figure 9.5 hai, jo upar di gayi hai. Sahi hawala (reference) Figure 9.5 hai.

blocks.prompt: Social media karobar ki promotion mein kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Products ki promotion karta hai aur tezi se bohat bare audience (dekhne walon) tak pohanchata hai.

items: Digital platforms karobar shuru, chalane aur barhane ke tools dete hain.
Social media: promotion aur bara audience.
